ChemSplash

A Ketcher-based chemical structure editor for Windows

HomeImprint

Professional Chemical Structure Editing

ChemSplash is a native Windows desktop application based on Ketcher. Create and edit molecules, reaction schemes and chemical diagrams in a clean desktop environment.

Features

  • Create and edit chemical structures
  • Draw reactions and molecular diagrams
  • Import and export supported Ketcher formats
  • Native Windows desktop application
  • Clean editing workflow

Privacy

ChemSplash does not collect or transmit personal data. The application runs locally on your device.
